plan: Keep adapt pure: build working copies of ingredients, instructions, and equipment up front; never touch the input recipe, request, or catalog.
Scale all quantities by a single Fraction ratio target_yield / recipe yield, applied uniformly to authored and catalog-added ingredients.

Process ingredients through a worklist queue so replacement names and additional ingredients re-enter the same exclusion check, giving chained substitution and reintroduced-exclusion detection uniformly.
Detect cycles with a per-ingredient chain-of-names list; a repeated name produces the 'substitution cycle involving NAME' reason.
Select catalog choices deterministically by minimizing the key (priority, catalog index).
Accumulate all impossibility reasons in a set across every ingredient plus a final equipment-availability pass, returning them sorted so no reason is dropped.

Apply wording changes as substring replacements on copied instruction strings, warning when the old text is absent; accumulate yield_factor adjustments globally and divide them back out so the final recipe is exactly at target yield.
print_original returns authored_text unchanged; embed the seven-scenario acceptance suite under __main__.
mechanisms: single Fraction scale ratio applied at ingredient-copy time
worklist queue of ingredient working copies for chained and additional-ingredient substitution
per-ingredient name-chain list for cycle detection
(priority, catalog index) minimization for deterministic choice selection
reason set accumulated across all ingredients and equipment, emitted sorted
copy-on-entry purity: new dicts/lists everywhere, deepcopy for components, authored_text passthrough
substring wording replacement with not-found warnings
global yield_factor accumulator with post-substitution rescale to target yield
